cohort: The study included 636 women (277 with isolated oligohydramnios and 359 controls) whose gestational age was between 32 and 41 weeks.
finding: Isolated oligohydramnios was associated with poorer birth and composite perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Isolated oligohydramnios was linked to a higher emergency cesarean section rate, and labor induction in women with isolated oligohydramnios further increased the emergency cesarean section rate without negative impact on perinatal morbidity.
